/apis/v1/notion-com/developer-documentat:
Notion's plans and prices from www.notion.com/pricing in one call: each plan card (Free, Plus, Business, Enterprise) with its description, the price as displayed, and both the monthly-billing and annual-billing list prices from the page's embedded price table (annual as the yearly total and per month), so no billing toggle is needed. Also other priced products on the page (Notion AI add-on, AI credit packs, Sites custom domains, the student plan) and the feature comparison grid (section, feature, tooltip and each plan's value or check mark). Prices are in the currency the page serves (USD for US visitors).

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `plans` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `annual_price` | number | Per seat per year when billed annually. |
| `annual_price_id` | string |  |
| `annual_price_per_month` | number | annual_price / 12. |
| `description` | string |  |
| `display_price` | string | Price as shown on the card, e.g. `$10` (annual billing per member per month) or `Custom pricing`. |
| `display_unit` | string | e.g. `per member / month`. |
| `key` | string | Lowercase plan id, e.g. `plus`. |
| `monthly_price` | number | Per seat per month when billed monthly. |
| `monthly_price_id` | string |  |
| `plan` | string |  |
| `recommended` | boolean |  |

/apis/v1/play-google-com/media/app:
One Android app on Google Play: title, summary, description, developer (name, id, page, website, support email), icon, header image, screenshots, categories, content rating, install counts, price and in-app purchase range, release and last-update dates, version, what's new, privacy policy link, aggregate rating with histogram and review count, chart badge, and the `Similar apps` cluster the page embeds. Written reviews come from `app_reviews`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `categories` | object[] | Store categories of the app (name, category id, URL). |
| `chart` | object | Top-chart badge when the page shows one. |
| `content_rating` | string | Content rating label (`Everyone`, `Teen`). |
| `content_rating_notes` | string | Content rating descriptor (`Users Interact`). |
| `currency` | string | ISO 4217 currency of the storefront. |
| `description_html` | string | Full description as the store carries it (HTML line breaks). |
| `developer_email` | string | Developer support email as listed on the store page. |
| `developer_id` | string | Numeric developer id when the page carries one. |
| `developer_name` | string |  |
| `developer_url` | string | Developer page (`/store/apps/developer?id=<name>`); feed the name to `developer_apps`. |
| `developer_website` | string | Developer website link. |
| `free` | boolean | True when the store price is zero. |
| `header_image_url` | string | Feature graphic. |
| `icon_url` | string | App icon. |
| `in_app_purchases` | string | In-app purchase price range as displayed (`$0.40 - $199.99 per item`); null when none. |
| `installs_display` | string | Install bucket as displayed (`10,000,000,000+`). |
| `installs_estimate` | number | The store's install count estimate behind the bucket. |
| `installs_min` | number | Lower bound of the install bucket. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | When the program read the source, milliseconds since the Unix epoch. |
| `package` | string |  |
| `price_display` | string | Price as displayed; null for free apps (the store shows an empty label). |
| `price_micros` | number | Store price in micros of `currency`; 0 for free apps; null when the page carries no offer. |
| `privacy_policy_url` | string | Privacy policy link. |
| `rating` | object | Aggregate rating across all devices (record slot 51); null when the store shows no ratings for the app. |
| `recent_changes_html` | string | What's new text (HTML line breaks). |
| `released` | string | Release date as displayed. |
| `released_at_ms` | number | Release timestamp, milliseconds since the Unix epoch. |
| `screenshots` | string[] |  |
| `similar` | object[] | Related app clusters the detail page shows inline (`Similar apps`), up to the items the page embeds. |

| `summary` | string | Short promotional line. |
| `title` | string |  |
| `updated` | string | Last update date as displayed. |
| `updated_at_ms` | number | Last update timestamp, milliseconds since the Unix epoch. |
| `url` | string | Canonical store details URL. |
| `version` | string | Current version string; null when the store says it varies with device. |

/apis/v1/littlecaesars-com/restaurants/g:
Delivery fee quote for a US street address (POST /api/v1/store/{n}/can-deliver, the order app's delivery eligibility check): the delivery fee, service fee rate, small order fee and its threshold, minimum order and estimated delivery time. Without `location_number` the delivering store is resolved first (POST /api/v1/search/find-delivery-store). No cart, order or payment is created. An address the site will not deliver to returns `fee_status: not_deliverable` with null fees.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `address_validated` | boolean | True when the site accepted the address for delivery. |
| `currency` | string |  |
| `delivery_address` | object | The address that was quoted, as sent. |
| `delivery_fee` | number | Delivery fee in USD (deliveryFees.vendorFee, the amount the order app's fee disclaimer quotes). Null when no fee is published or the address is not deliverable. |
| `estimated_delivery_time` | string | Delivery estimate as the site words it, e.g. 33-38 min. |
| `fee_status` | string | available: a fee was quoted. not_published: the store accepted the address but returned no fee. not_deliverable: no store delivers to the address. |
| `lce_delivery_fee` | number | Additional Little Caesars delivery fee component (lceDeliveryFee), 0 when none. |
| `location_number` | number | Store that quoted the fee; null when no store delivers to the address. |
| `minimum_order_amount` | number | Minimum delivery subtotal (minimumDeliveryThreshold), 0 when none. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Milliseconds since the Unix epoch when this result was fetched. |
| `quote_type` | string |  |
| `service_fee_rate` | number | Service fee as a fraction of the order subtotal (lceServiceFee, 0.12 = 12%). The order app's disclaimer caps it at $4.00. |
| `small_order_fee` | number | Fee added to orders under small_order_fee_threshold, unless a promotion waives it. |
| `small_order_fee_threshold` | number | Subtotal under which the small order fee applies. |
| `source` | string | The endpoint that answered. |
| `status_message` | string | The site's message when the address is not deliverable. |
| `store_source` | string | Whether the store came from the input or was resolved from the address. |
